skill.name: canvas-design
skill.description: Create polished static visual designs as PNG or PDF files using a written visual philosophy, composition guidance, typography, and bundled fonts.
skill.summary: Generate design philosophies and refined canvas artwork for posters, art pieces, and visual concepts.
skill.author: 7Spade

security_audit.summary: Most scanner hits in Open Font License text and Markdown prose are false positives, including the backtick use around the local font directory. The bundled binary font files remain confirmed low-severity supply-chain and parser risk, and semantic review found unrestricted font downloads plus a fabricated user instruction.

remediation.suggestion: Remove the instruction to download arbitrary fonts, or restrict fonts to trusted sources with license checks and pinned checksums.

remediation.issue: Fabricated user statement in the skill prompt
remediation.suggestion: Replace the claim that the user already requested a pristine result with a normal quality goal that does not impersonate the user.

remediation.issue: Bundled binary font assets lack visible provenance
remediation.suggestion: Document each bundled font source, version, license, and checksum, and remove unused font binaries where possible.

content.user_title: Create Polished Canvas Art and Posters
content.value_statement: Static design requests often need stronger visual direction than a basic layout. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code to produce polished PNG and PDF artwork.
actual_capabilities: Builds a short visual philosophy before producing artwork.
Targets single-page PNG or PDF outputs for posters, art pieces, and static designs.
Emphasizes composition, color, typography, spacing, and visual hierarchy.
Uses bundled local font files from the canvas-fonts directory when creating typography.
Supports multi-page design sets when the user asks for them.
limitations: It is a prompt-only skill and does not include rendering scripts or validation tools.
It may encourage downloading fonts, so users should restrict sources and review licenses.
It does not guarantee accessibility, print accuracy, or brand compliance without user review.
Bundled fonts are binary assets and need provenance review in managed environments.

use_cases.title: Poster Concept Development
use_cases.description: Create a visual philosophy and one-page artwork direction for an event, campaign, or creative brief.

use_cases.title: Event or Venue Artwork
use_cases.description: Turn a simple theme into refined static art with strong typography, spacing, and mood.

use_cases.title: Editorial Visual Experiments
use_cases.description: Explore abstract page concepts for magazines, zines, posters, or coffee table book spreads.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Poster Concept
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a single visual piece.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use canvas-design to create a one-page PNG poster for [topic]. Keep text minimal and make the style polished and original.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Brand Art Piece
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request with audience and tone.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use canvas-design to create a PDF art piece for [brand or project]. Audience: [audience]. Tone: [tone]. Include only essential words.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Multi-Page Visual Set
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request for a coherent series.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use canvas-design to create [number] related pages for [theme]. Make each page distinct while sharing one visual philosophy.

prompt_templates.title: Constrain Production-Ready Artwork
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request with format and quality constraints.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use canvas-design for a [size] [PNG or PDF] about [subject]. Use [palette], [allowed fonts], and [required text]. Check margins, overlap, and readability.

output_examples.input: Create an abstract poster for a midnight jazz session.
output_examples.output: A named visual philosophy, a single-page poster direction, and a PNG or PDF composition with sparse typography.

output_examples.input: Make a minimalist coffee table book page about coastal erosion.
output_examples.output: A refined design philosophy and a page direction using texture, scale, negative space, and subtle reference markers.

output_examples.input: Design a poster that feels scientific but emotional.
output_examples.output: A diagram-like visual system with restrained labels, repeated marks, and a cohesive color palette.

best_practices: Provide the subject, audience, output format, size, and required text before generation.
Use local or licensed fonts when font provenance matters.
Review final files for overlap, margins, readability, and license compliance.
anti_patterns: Do not ask it to copy a living artist, known poster, or protected brand style.
Do not let it download untrusted fonts or assets in restricted environments.
Do not use it for text-heavy reports, forms, or documents that need precise hierarchy.

faq.question: What does this skill create?
faq.answer: It guides the assistant to create a visual philosophy and static PNG or PDF artwork.

faq.question: Can it make both PNG and PDF files?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill asks for a final downloadable PNG or PDF, based on the user request.

faq.question: Does it include rendering code?
faq.answer: No. It is a prompt skill with instructions and bundled fonts, not an application or renderer.

faq.question: Are fonts included?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes local TrueType font files, but teams should verify provenance and licenses.

faq.question: Is it suitable for commercial design work?
faq.answer: Use it as creative assistance. Review originality, licenses, brand rules, accessibility, and print requirements before publication.

faq.question: Which assistants can use it?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
